options.text: What do you have for sale?

steps.player: What's with the duck?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Oh, it's part of a little test I'd like to do. A travelling salesman stopped off here a while ago and claimed you can use a duck to accurately track currents in the sea.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: My plan is to track the currents around Catherby to see if I can speed up the docking process, but there's a bit of a snag...

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: The local council have a by-law forbidding non-human workers from doing business in Catherby. I'd hoped the local councillor wouldn't notice, but the second the duck arrived, she came along making threats of a fine!
If the player does not meet the requirements to begin the quest:

steps.player: Anything I can do to help?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I don't think so, but thanks for the offer.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Current Affairs quest.

steps.player: Anything I can do to help?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, you're welcome to try talking to Councillor Catherine yourself. You'll find her in the Council Office north east of here. I warn you though, it will probably be an uphill struggle!

steps.player: Thanks for the warning. I'll head over and see what I can do.
I'm sorry to hear that. Hopefully you manage to work something out.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Thank you, friend.

options.text: Where abouts do you make deliveries to?
What do you have for sale?
Where can I find the Council Office?

steps.player: Where can I find the Council Office?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: It's just north east of here. Good luck trying to deal with Councillor Catherine though.

options.text: Where abouts do you make deliveries to?

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.player: Hello there. Are you Councillor Catherine? I was hoping you could help me with something.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: Thank you for enquiring at the Catherby Council Office. Your views are important to us. What is it I can do for you today?

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.player: I had a question about one of the local by-laws. Apparently non-human workers aren't allowed to do business in Catherby?
Doesn't that strike you as a bit... wrong?

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: If you are referring to the rumours of Humans Against Monsters sympathies within the Catherby Council, then I can assure you that a full impartial investigation found those rumours to be totally false.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.player: I see... So you wouldn't even be willing to let Arhein's duck track a few currents? The results would be very useful, not just to Arhein. I imagine any sailor docking here would find them helpful.
Well, yes, I suppose you could say that.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: All sailors doing business in Catherby must first be registered with the Catherby Council. Doing so requires completion of the appropriate form which is the fourth in the port series of the Catherby Registry form group.
Councillor Catherine hands you a form.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: Please ensure when filling in the form that all answers are clearly legible. Failure to do so may result in unnecessary processing delays.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.player: But why do I need to...

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: Thanks to recent budget changes, I'm pleased to confirm that the Catherby Council are now able to provide charcoal free of charge. If required, you can find some in the cabinet to my left.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: Upon completion, please return the form to the Catherby Council Office at your earliest convenience.

red-tape-searching-the-cabinet.text: You search the cabinet and find some charcoal.

red-tape-filling-out-form-cr-4p.text: You start looking through the questions on the form...

red-tape-filling-out-form-cr-4p.prompt: What is your main reason for making port at Catherby?
How many hulls does your ship have?
Is your ship insured against cargo spillage and theft?
Does your first mate have first aid training?
Does your second mate have second aid training?
Have you experienced symptoms of plague in the last two weeks?
How much experience do you have sailing?
Where would you say your home port is?

red-tape-filling-out-form-cr-4p.text: Mercifully, it looks like the form is finished.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: Have you fully filled in that form?

steps.player: Yes, I have it here.

steps.text: Councillor Catherine looks over the form.
If the player has not fully filled out form cr-4p:

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: I am afraid there are still questions missing answers. Please make sure you fully fill the form in before you hand it in.
If the player has fully filled out form cr-4p:

steps.player: Yes, I have it here.

steps.text: Councillor Catherine takes the completed form.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Thank you very much. However, I must inform you that the Catherby Council is currently experiencing higher than usual volumes of enquiries, so there may be some delays in the processing of your form.

steps.player: Okay... I don't actually really care about the form though.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Then what is it I can help you with?

steps.player: That by-law about non-humans... I want to get it changed.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Any change to the by-laws can only occur with approval from the Mayor of Catherby.

steps.player: Right, we're getting somewhere. Where can I find the mayor?

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: I'm afraid that due to the Catherby Data Protection Regulation, I am not at liberty to give out personal information on the mayor.

steps.player: Are you serious?

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Very serious. Now, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: We hope your experience was a positive one, but if you do have any feedback, I'd be more than happy to provide you with the relevant form.

steps.player: Yeah... I think I'll pass on that.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Then I wish you a very good day.

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Please ensure that you have done so before you hand it in. Please also ensure that all answers are clearly legible. Failure to do so may result in unnecessary processing delays.

steps.speaker: Councillor Catherine
steps.text: Thanks to recent budget changes, I'm pleased to confirm that the Catherby Council are now able to provide charcoal free of charge. If required, you can find some in the cabinet to my left.

steps.player: Okay.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.player: I need to speak to the mayor.

red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.speaker: Councillor Catherine
red-tape-talking-to-councillor-catherine.text: I'm afraid that due to the Catherby Data Protection Regulation, I am not at liberty to give out personal information on the mayor. Now, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.

options.text: What do you have for sale?
I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

steps.player: I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: The mayor? Oh no...

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I'm afraid to say that the mayor died a few days ago.

steps.player: Oh... I'm sorry to hear that.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Don't worry, it happens all the time.

steps.player: It does? That feels like the kind of thing I should be worried about...

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Why do you need the mayor anyway?

steps.player: Apparently only the mayor can approve a change to the by-laws.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Really? I don't recall that ever stopping Catherine before, but if she insists, I guess we can do this song and dance once more.

steps.player: Meaning?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: We're going to need another mayor, but we need to make sure Catherine doesn't notice.

steps.player: Where on Gielinor will we get another mayor? And how in the name of Guthix's trousers will Catherine not notice?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, the Mayor of Catherby has been, for a long time now, a fish.

steps.player: A fish?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Actually, to be precise, it has been 26 different fish, 25 of which were doing a fantastic job of pretending to be the first.

steps.player: I'm not sure this democracy thing is going to catch on if it keeps being implemented this badly.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, unfortunately no one in Catherby really wanted the job. In fact, there was only one candidate, and it was the one person we all definitely didn't want to be the mayor.

steps.player: Councillor Catherine?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Councillor Catherine.

steps.player: So the answer was a fish?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: It seemed like a good idea at the time. Problem is, Catherine responded by introducing that by-law preventing non-humans from working here.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: We were lucky that a different by-law she'd already introduced clearly stated that the mayor serves until death.

steps.player: Of course. And as a result, you now need to make sure she doesn't know the mayor died.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.player: Right...
I'll help you replace the fish.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: A wise choice. Go and see Harry at the fishing shop. He should be able to help.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: You'll need to go and see Harry at the fishing shop. He should be able to help you sort out a replacement mayor.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, desperate times...
